description: Import & Export Control Department - Import & Export Control Regulation No. 02 of 2019
categorisation: This gazette content consists of regulations made by the Minister under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, specifically amending import license regulations and schedules. It deals with legal/regulatory matters including amendments to existing regulations, import controls, and HS code modifications, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While a minister is named, this is incidental to the regulatory content rather than being about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
